title: StorySpark: Module-wise Evolutionary Search for Story Premise Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A story premise is the creative spark from which a full narrative can grow. Yet LLM-based story generation has mostly emphasized later-stage planning, controllability, coherence, and prose expansion, while premise-level ideation remains comparatively underexplored. We introduce StorySpark, a module-wise evolutionary search framework for story premise generation. StorySpark operates over interpretable narrative modules such as background, persona, event, ending, and twist, treating each active module not as a static field to fill once, but as a local search space conditioned on the partial premise built so far. For each module, it generates alternatives, evaluates them in context, refines them through feedback-driven mutation and recombination, preserves complementary strengths with Pareto-guided selection, and reallocates frontier capacity to balance branch coverage with promising directions. Multi-view automatic and human evaluations

translated_title: StorySpark：面向故事前提生成的模块化进化搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12336v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：故事前提是完整叙事得以发展的创意火花。然而，基于大语言模型的故事生成大多侧重于后期规划、可控性、连贯性和散文扩展，而前提层面的构思相对未被充分探索。我们提出了StorySpark，一种用于故事前提生成的模块化进化搜索框架。StorySpark在可解释的叙事模块（如背景、人物、事件、结局和转折）上运行，将每个活跃模块视为一个局部搜索空间，该空间基于迄今构建的部分前提而条件化，而非一次性填充的静态字段。对于每个模块，它生成替代方案，在上下文中评估它们，通过反馈驱动的变异和重组进行细化，通过帕累托引导的选择保留互补优势，并重新分配前沿能力以平衡分支覆盖与有前景的方向。多视角自动和人工评估表明，StorySpark在生成质量和多样性方面显著优于现有基线，生成的前提在叙事吸引力、连贯性和创造性方面获得更高评分，同时保持结构多样性和可控性。
tldr: StorySpark通过模块化进化搜索框架，将故事前提生成分解为可解释的叙事模块，并利用帕累托引导的选择和反馈驱动变异，显著提升了生成前提的创意性和多样性。
en_tdlr: StorySpark introduces a module-wise evolutionary search framework that decomposes story premise generation into interpretable narrative modules, using Pareto-guided selection and feedback-driven mutation to significantly enhance premise creativity and diversity.
